name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short text label that appears on hover or keyboard focus to name or explain a control.

examples.name: tooltip-demo
examples.title: Tooltip
examples.description: Adds a hint to a labelled button.

examples.name: tooltip-on-icon-button
examples.title: Icon buttons
examples.description: Shows the accessible name of icon-only buttons to sighted users.

examples.name: tooltip-placement
examples.title: Placement
examples.description: top, bottom, start and end; start and end follow the reading direction.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side. Flips when there is no room.

props.name: showArrow
props.description: Draws an arrow pointing at the trigger.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance from the trigger in px.

props.name: delay
props.description: Hover delay in ms before the first tooltip opens. Keyboard focus opens immediately.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Delay in ms before closing after the pointer leaves.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Open only on keyboard focus, not hover.

keyboard.action: Focusing the trigger shows the tooltip immediately.
Hides the tooltip without moving focus.

notes: role="tooltip"; the trigger is described by it via aria-describedby while it is open.
Hover opening starts after the user has used a pointer on the page (React Aria's interaction modality); keyboard focus always opens it.
Tooltips are not reachable on touch devices: never put essential information or interactive content in them.

Overlays render in a portal on <body>, outside any ThemeScope. When it opens, the overlay looks up data-strata-theme, data-strata-scheme, data-strata-density, dir and lang — each on the nearest ancestor that has it — starting from its trigger (or from where the component is rendered, when controlled), and copies them onto its own root — so it uses the same tenant tokens and direction as the page region it came from, and nested overlays inherit from their parent overlay.

do: Pair every icon-only button with a Tooltip repeating its aria-label.
Keep it to a few words.
dont: Don't put links or buttons in a tooltip — use a Popover.
Don't use tooltips on disabled buttons to explain why; show the reason inline.
